storyInfo: The Infected group is taken into custody for violating curfew. Hierda stops the Generalik from massacring the innocent. Tonya ponders her options after Crownslayer leaves and encounters a woman. Scioppa returns to his formation, hides the truth about his coercion, and prepares to set out for Zelgrad. Sirka is rescued by a mysterious figure.

attributes.text: '...Pavel, when there is danger, let the students leave first; they're easiest to identify, and likely to be considered less of a threat.'
'Their Tulskaya Technical School background makes them a higher priority for retention amongst the Infected. More numbers will be preserved if they get away.'
'All life is equal, of course, but sacrifice is inevitable in our work. We must all maximize the value of our lives for the cause.'
'Is it sad? Perhaps, but I do not have the luxury to wallow in sorrow. I must save my strength for anger and resistance.'
'That though the winter night be long and cold, have faith that the sun will shine again upon us equally.'

attributes.content: We're under the Second District. I remember the pillars marked with different colors in this passage. The exit is just ahead.
attributes.name: Serious Student

attributes.content: Are we just going to leave like this? What about your comrades who're staying behind?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: If the Teacher and Pavel wanted us to leave, there must be a reason for it. Maybe they'll join us after fighting off the soldiers.
attributes.name: Serious Student

attributes.content: Shh—hide, someone's coming!
attributes.name: Serious Student

attributes.content: I saw someone. They must have went this way.
attributes.name: Nervous Voice

attributes.content: Don't get distracted. The other Infected don't matter, but the Generalik wants that Cautus found at any cost!
attributes.name: Fierce Voice

attributes.content: They're looking for... me?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: <p=1>Third District Apartments, Zelgrad</><p=2> Jan 21, 1102, 03:31</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Put down your weapons and you'll be spared!
attributes.name: Robotic Voice

attributes.content: Put down your weapons—
attributes.name: Robotic Voice

attributes.content: Turn that thing off.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Y-Yes, sir!
attributes.name: Deferential Soldier

attributes.content: Turn off the speakers!
attributes.name: Deferential Soldier

attributes.content: There's fewer of them than I thought. Report.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Yes, sir.
attributes.name: Deferential Soldier

attributes.content: At around 0300 hours, patrols found a group near the entrance to the Third District underground, apparently attempting to gain access to the residential district through the underground layer.
attributes.name: Deferential Soldier

attributes.content: We were outnumbered and the Marshal gave express orders not to harm Infected resources, causing us to lose track of some of them during the chase—
attributes.name: Deferential Soldier

attributes.content: The killer presses his forehead, trying to soothe the splitting headache. He did not even look before swinging his sword.
...Someone who can talk better.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: S-Sir!
attributes.name: Honest Soldier

attributes.content: There were more of them, but the patrol was short-handed, which allowed some of them to escape to the underground layer before we could confirm their identity.
attributes.name: Honest Soldier

attributes.content: The complexity of the underground layer makes tracking difficult. However, such a mistake should not have happened to begin with! It was our error!
attributes.name: Honest Soldier

attributes.content: You talk well and you know how to reflect. But that can't wipe clean the mistake, can it?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I-I—
attributes.name: Honest Soldier

attributes.content: The soldier reflexively glances at the still-warm body of his comrade lying on the ground.
He remembers the rumors: Generalik Anatoliy hates people who are talkative, people who overestimate themselves, and—
He hates liars.
I will accept any punishment! / Perhaps I should explain.
attributes.name: Honest Soldier & Calm Youth

attributes.content: You—what?
attributes.name: Honest Soldier

attributes.content: Perhaps I should explain. I was directly involved, after all.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: A volunteering hero. What do you say to the charges of illegal gathering and resisting arrest that you and your friends are facing?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Uchitel—
attributes.name: Pavel

attributes.content: (Shakes head)
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: We did not resist arrest, because we were not gathering illegally. We have stayed to await justice.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Disappointing. I thought you'd have something new to say...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You bore me.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: The Generalik turns around to face his soldiers before the calm youth has a chance to add anything.
The Infected here refused to cooperate with you, didn't they?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: That's resisting arrest.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Sir!
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: So it looks like you have no idea what to do if there are more than a couple of people resisting arrest.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Foolish and inflexible.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I accept any punishment—
attributes.name: Honest Soldier

attributes.content: But I am magnanimous, and therefore I will show you what to do in these circumstances.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: He moves.
The sword reaches the calm youth first. She would not have been able to avoid it, if someone had not pulled her out of the way.
Argh—
attributes.name: Pavel

attributes.content: —Pavel!
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Even after the youth saw the sword take the life of a trained soldier, it is hard to accept that it has now taken one of their comrades just as easily.
The older miner did not have time to even utter a word. His eyes wide, his life frozen at the instant when he grabbed the youth's hands.
Only when there are screams and sobbing coming from behind does the youth realize what has transpired.
You make an example, like this. If killing one isn't enough, kill another, until they cooperate.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Mother's orders are important, of course, but under extraordinary circumstances such as these... does it matter whether the Infected is alive or dead?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I have made this decision. I, Anatoliy Svetlanov Buterin, take full responsibility for everything that happens here.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Now, before I cut off another head, who's going to tell me where your unruly friends have gone?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You're mad! We won't—
attributes.name: Angry Miner

attributes.content: The bodies on the ground lie as evidence of the two lives that have departed.
They dye the soles of the youth's boots red, but she does not look down. She looks up, straight into the Generalik's eyes.
Why the anger? You failed. That's the truth that no amount of killing will change.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: You claim you have the power to do anything, but you clearly can't get your way. You can't pry open our mouths with your sword, nor will you learn what you want to know.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: We have bought precious time for our comrades, while you thrash about, locked in the cage of your own anger.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: How dare you—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Fury twists the young man's visage. He wants to raise the butcher's knife again, but he cannot find a sliver of the fear he seeks in the youth's face.
And the whole lot of companions behind as well. Miners, farmers, nothing more, yet not a single one panics or flinches. He is unaccustomed to this reaction, or lack thereof.
Suddenly, Anatoliy realizes that he would simply be creating willing martyrs.
...Enough.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I've seen too many hackneyed tropes tonight.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Kill them all and clean up the mess. Then find—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Stop!
Hierda?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Hierda!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I'm sorry, Anatoliy, I heard you were here—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: You came back! You didn't flee!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: But why did you leave on your own?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You should be by my side always. This was your promise. Don't you know what a promise is?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I... I'm sorry for the misunderstanding.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: But... what's happening here?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Anatoliy tries to block Hierda's line of sight, but he can do nothing to mask the smell.
The scent of blood fills the air, even in the cold night.
...Anatoliy.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: You promised not to kill more innocent people.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Hierda tries her best not to sound accusing. She does not want to anger Anatoliy, or further escalate the situation.
If only there was a manual on how to deal with a fickle, temperamental child with too much power over life and death...
Yes, I promised.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Anatoliy...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: But you didn't keep your end of the bargain. You left me.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I was only doing what I could while you slept. I said this to you, and you agreed.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: If I agreed to anything, it was only under the condition that you stayed with me.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: ...I don't know how we can carry on, if you keep changing the conditions—
attributes.name: Hierda
Anatoliy
attributes.content: 'Don't know how we can carry on'?

attributes.name: Anatoliy
attributes.content: You don't know how you can continue to stay by my side?
No, listen to me—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Who planted such terrible thoughts in your mind? Who instilled such ideas in you—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You never questioned me before!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: The sword is tossed aside, like a piece of scrap metal.
Anatoliy grabs the Cautus's slim shoulders. Then, amidst the surprised cries, his right knee hits the floor—
He kneels down in front of Hierda.
Oh—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I see you've suffered a malign influence. Tell me, what should I do? How can I change your mind?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Only I can realize your vision and bring glory to your great blessing—as long as you don't leave my side again.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I forgive you! I forgive all your mistakes, for leaving without a word.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: But please, don't leave me again... never again say these terrible words.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: ...I promise.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: As long as you promise never to kill another innocent...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: As she picks her words, Hierda looks at the corpses lying in the middle of the road, and the Infected behind them.
Most of them have the same expressions on their faces, pained and wary.
Promise not to harm these Infected anymore... not to take any innocent lives.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: And I will promise in turn.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I'll stay by your side, and never leave again.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Lieutenant.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: ...Yes, Generalik?
attributes.name: Brave Servant

attributes.content: Herd these scum back to the residential district and put them in an empty apartment.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Station an artillery regiment to keep a close eye on them.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Anatoliy?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Enough. Waste no more time on these dregs.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Let us go.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: A lone figure sits in the warehouse. She has sat there through the night, until dawn begins to crack upon the horizon.
'Convince them that this is a matter of life and death'...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: How should I tell them...?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Zelgrad is not home...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Are you alright, Tonya?
Doctor Nadezhda Pavlovna...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Sorry to keep you waiting. I've been getting a lot of emergency patients lately.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: You don't look well. Do you want something to calm your nerves?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: No, I'm fine. I appreciate everything you've done for me and my sister.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Her condition—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Slow down, Tonya. You only brought her yesterday. I need to keep her condition under control first, and I still have questions for you.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: First, have similar symptoms appeared on other members of your family?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: No, not yet.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Just to be safe, I've entrusted my other siblings in the care of my neighbors, and checked for the source of infection according to your instructions.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Did you find it?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: There's only one possibility... my work jacket.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: It was issued to us at work, very thick and warm, so I put it around Nina those few days when the power went out... I shouldn't have done it!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: She's at home all day. The only thing from the outside she could have come into contact with was that jacket.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: And I found a strange... powder on it when I checked it.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Powder?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Yes... I've never seen anything like it. It clung to the surface of the jacket like some kind of dust. Probably got on it while I was washing the clothes.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Whose clothes?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: The First Army... or rather, the First Army's researchers.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: You mean this has something to do with them?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: ...We can't be sure yet.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I know what you're thinking, Tonya, but right now there's no way to prove that the powder caused the illness.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: We'll have to get past that wall to find out.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: ...What will happen to my sister? What will the illness do to her?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I'm sorry, Tonya, but I haven't found anything similar to this in the books.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I don't even know if it's just a singular incident or not, until more patients present themselves.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I need more information about this strange new illness.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: *sigh*...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Not a good feeling, is it, to be the only one awake?
attributes.name: Elegant Voice

attributes.content: Yes... I don't how I can make the others believe me.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Do not blame your friends.
attributes.name: Elegant Voice

attributes.content: Perhaps the land has never promised a future for them, not since the day they were born. They lost the courage to face the truth when happiness is dangled before them.
attributes.name: Elegant Voice

attributes.content: They will not thank the one who wakes them; they will blame you for ruining their dream.
attributes.name: Elegant Voice

attributes.content: When the future is full of despair, short-sightedness becomes a survival mechanism.
attributes.name: Elegant Voice

attributes.content: I won't blame anyone... I know it doesn't seem like an immediate danger to them.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Wait, who are you?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I entered the city with the workers.
attributes.name: Elegant Woman

attributes.content: It wasn't my intention to disrupt your lives. I only came to see... an old friend.
attributes.name: Elegant Woman

attributes.content: Will she be here? I don't know... but she is rarely absent from spectacular occasions.
attributes.name: Elegant Woman

attributes.content: I don't understand what you're saying. If there's nothing else—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: How unfortunate. I do understand what you're saying... and what you're looking for.
attributes.name: Elegant Woman

attributes.content: I help the sleeping wake up, and make the weak strong.
attributes.name: Elegant Woman

attributes.content: Perhaps we can help each other... if you're willing.
attributes.name: Elegant Woman

attributes.content: Ah, I see I forgot to introduce myself—
attributes.name: Elegant Woman

attributes.content: Nice to meet you, Tonya. I'm a teacher. You may call me... Koshelna.
attributes.name: Koshelna

attributes.content: (I think I lost them for real this time...)
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: (They were strictly aiming for my legs. Were they trying to immobilize me? Why didn't they shoot to kill?)
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: This is strange...
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: ...Ugh—
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: You're bleeding. The smell will draw pursuers.
Who—
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Let's keep it brief.
I know what you did, and I took care of some of your pursuers. At the current rate, your blood loss will send you into shock in three minutes.
I'll staunch your bleeding, then take you to a place that's... relatively safe.
Who are you?
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: That's not important, and it's not like you have any other choice. Maybe you could try to stab me with your final breath... but would that be worth it?
Yes, that's more like it.
Keep quiet and conserve your energy.
<p=1>Third District Apartments, Zelgrad</><p=2> Jan 21, 1102, 02:16</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: I went and got a look, Red. Guess what?
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: The people that we ran into during the day and the folks that came in with them are all gone. Third floor through fifth floor are empty, and we hardly heard any footsteps.
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: I pried open a few locks just to make sure—
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: Next time don't pry the locks, just knock.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: If they're anything like us, they wouldn't have been sleeping well the first night here.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Do you think they were taken away quietly like the previous group, or did they leave on their own?
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: They're all miners. I gather they came from the north based on their outfits, but it's not clear whether they're from the Far North.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Let's find that industrial district mentioned in the intel.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: I've never had the chance to ask, but do you really trust her that much? Maybe she wasn't really looking for the people who were taken away, and the intel's no good—
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: She had many chances to get us killed and run away in the last two years. Why hasn't she done so?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: How am I supposed to know what she's thinking?
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: Then shut your crap and don't let me hear that again, or you can go back to Nine and get your brain straightened out before coming out again.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: ...I'm just being vigilant!
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: You can, but only if you keep it to yourself at this stage.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: We're a very, very long way from having the luxury to settle old scores.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: There's no one here...
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: Doesn't look like anyone's been working here for a while, either. It's been abandoned for a long time.
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: There are holes in the roof, and no equipment in sight. Looks like it's all been moved.
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: Industrial transfer.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: When we first came, the soldier who acted as our guide told us that the previous tenants in our apartment were 'coincidentally' moved to other districts because of industrial transfer.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: No matter how 'coincidental', however, industrial transfer rarely takes place between different districts of a nomadic city.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: It's only megacities like Londinium and Grypherburg that have the demand and the capacity.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: And the corporations that performed industrial transfer in Londinium ultimately ended up moving their factories to smaller nomadic cities nearby, rather than other plates within the city.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: How do you know this stuff?
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: I read.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Fine...
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: But Zelgrad is just a medium-sized nomadic city... built upon a small-sized nomadic city, even, with unmapped expansion plates all over the place.
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: There are a lot of questions, but we'll have to take them one at a time. There's no one here, nor in the dorms either. For now we can eliminate—
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Wait.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: There's something up ahead—
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Hey!
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: No.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Valiya

attributes.content: You were right, next time, we should ask her what she's doing.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: She left someone here for us.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: It's typical Arts overload symptoms alright, with concurrent acute neurasthenia that makes single emergency medication less effective.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: There isn't much I can do other than prescribe sedatives and rest. She should refrain from using Arts until neurasthenia symptoms disappear.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: (Mutters) Thank goodness it wasn't that...
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: What do you mean?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: It's nothing... say, your description of the symptoms was quite accurate, and you performed appropriate early treatment. I take it you have a bit of medical knowledge?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: 'Have a bit of medical knowledge'? I'm—
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.options: We're from a pharmaceutical company.;We conduct research into Oripathy.
For certain reasons, however...;We don't have a doctor with us right now.

attributes.content: I see... interesting, isn't it, to have so many 'doctors' arrive in Zelgrad lately.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Well, I guess I'm done here. I'll go back now—
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: One moment, doctor!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Do you know anything else about the patient that I brought to your clinic?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Just another poor soul too far gone to be helped... what else are you expecting me to tell you?
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: You were not surprised to see his symptoms.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: You have seen others like him before, haven't you? How many other people have gotten the same illness here?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Oripathy isn't the only thing that kills people in this land.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: Besides, if something is being deliberately suppressed in Zelgrad, there's a reason for it, and I'm not going to look for trouble.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: I don't care what kind of doctor you are and why you came to Zelgrad. All I can tell you is that you shouldn't get involved in this stuff, and get out as soon as possible.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: But you haven't left.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: You haven't given up on helping the people here. Don't we share the same goal?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Don't flatter me. I'm just scraping a living by doing what I know how to do.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.options: We need a 'doctor' to help more people.;We trust any 'doctor' who's true to his or her duty.

attributes.content: Hah... listening to that stuff is what cost me my license. Talk is cheap.
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: But fine... I still don't recommend that you get involved, but if you insist on investigating...
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.content: One of the workers told me she took a piece of contaminated clothing from behind that wall...
attributes.name: Nadezhda

attributes.options: The problem is with whatever lies behind that wall.;Does that strange powder have something to do with the Sarcophagus?

attributes.content: Doctor, I'm worried about what Amiya and that doctor described...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Kal'tsit should have sealed the Sarcophagus five years ago.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: But Ursus is evidently hacking into the Sarcophagus very aggressively. I can't tell how far their research has progressed until I see the Sarcophagus myself.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: We can't afford to wait!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: I agree...
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Raidian! The doctor said you have to rest!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Maybe I'm not the one who should talk, but shouldn't an elite operator exercise better judgment? Stay in bed.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I encountered powerful countermeasures while trying to probe what's happening inside the wall... it's well-defended...
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Besides the army's electromagnetic jamming... the whole city's magnetic field feels strange...
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: I'm sorry, Doctor... I can't help for now...
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.options: You took on a great risk for us.;No one could have done better.

attributes.content: See? Listen to the Doctor, won't you? At least keep the blanket around you if you want to sit up. You were shivering just now.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: But we do have to act quickly.

attributes.content: Based on what I saw, there are more strange things going on in Zelgrad than we thought.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: That gravely ill patient, the strange creature... the First Army must be hiding something terrible.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: The First Army seems to be uncooperative towards the State Council. It's unlikely that they'll help us.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: We can't sit around and wait.;We need to get through that wall.

attributes.content: We have plenty of experience with situations like this! Leave the fighting to me!
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: There's no such thing as an impregnable wall. Even the Armies of Ursus make mistakes.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: If you ever need someone to hack through a firewall, I'm right here!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: It's very late. The garrison is probably on alert right now from all the commotion.;Let's look for a way to get through the wall during the day.

attributes.content: Stop walking around like that, mudak! You're making my eyes hurt.
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: It's been two days since they took the boss. When are you gonna go and get him out?
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: We have contingencies for situations like this. If he isn't back after one week, and there's no movement outside, Oleg will take over and we'll get ready to scram...
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Are you out of your mind, svolotsch? Boss was telling us to be flexible, not run away at the slightest sign of trouble!
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: There isn't much difference.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Of course there is. Don't you remember what we sing when we drink? 'Volniki have two paths to freedom, one they carve out with their swords, the other when they bleed and fall'—
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: We haven't done anything except bite like an obedient tuskbeast ever since we came here!
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: Kuznetsov's people are everywhere. We'll be detected immediately if we leave the base during the ceasefire. Right now, we need to keep the ship safe, and say nothing if anyone asks.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Oleg is already planning the retreat.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: At least we need to make those mudak pay the price for looking down on us.
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: Is that more important than your life?
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: But we're not that lunatic Kuznetsov's pet tuskbeasts!
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: Even a tuskbeast will bite through its fence if cornered. Sirka would agree with me, if she was here.
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: But she's not.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: You're right, though. We would be making a night visit to the flagship right now if Sirka was here.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: I'm starting to miss her. Should've learned those tricks of hers. Damn it all...
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: Enough slacking! Scioppa's back, and in one piece!
attributes.name: Excited Officer

attributes.content: You have three minutes to hide your liquor and smokes and illegal Arts units—
attributes.name: Excited Officer

attributes.content: We weren't drinking!
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: Or smoking. And we already hid our Arts units in case Kuznetsov sends another inspector. They took a bunch with them the last time, even ones that were still being repaired.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Where's the boss, Oleg?
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: On deck! No one knows when he came back. He was standing there when I saw him.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: He just smiled when I asked, saying that everything's good. You know how people have been on edge since that incident in December.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: What's our next step? Are we still leaving?
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: The alarm's cancelled for now. Go back to your posts. I'll make another round; I'll let you know if anything happens—
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: There you are, Oleg.
Boss!
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: I want everyone who's awake out on deck.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I have a important announcement to make.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: <p=1>Assault Ship Volnov, Upper Deck</><p=2> Jan 21, 1102, 02:45</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Is everyone here?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Everyone on the night shift.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Inform the others after the shift change.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: What's going on? The last time you called all hands was...
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Remember the bomb that went off in Central recently?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Who could forget? We could feel it all the way here. They say it left nothing except some strange-colored dust. The sight of the Viy eating someone could hardly be more terrible.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Hah, the Viy eating someone... you're right.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: That's the First Army's new weapon, which the people above really want to get their hands on. That's when the Special Tactics Formation comes in handy.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: The man shrugs and turns around to face the others, which fall silent as he opens his mouth. His smile never leaves his face as he raises his voice.
In other words, we just got a big job.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: What do you mean?
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: Are you saying—
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Yes, we're going to steal the First Army's new weapon.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Wait a second. Going to the First Army's position means passing through the front lines, right? Which means we'll have to deal with the Second Army. Is that even possible?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Or are we going to go around—
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Or is it just a part of some kind of operation?
attributes.name: Confused Soldier

attributes.content: Maybe we just need to carry out our orders, like when we put down that mutiny.
attributes.name: Confused Soldier

attributes.content: You're right. His High Excellency Marshal Evgeny Andrianov Kuznetsov has made arrangements for us to pass the Second Army's lines safely.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: All we need to do is...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Advance.
attributes.name: Scioppa
